release_notes:
Google Play compliant update flow, update gate freeze fixes, and stability improvements.

Added
- Google Play store update link integration for store builds

Changed
- Soft update mechanism so users are never blocked from accessing the app

Fixed
- Resolved download hang on in-app updater
- Removed restricted Android package install permissions
